title: North Atlantic right whale population estimate

source.name: Population size estimation of North Atlantic right whales from 1990-2024 (NEFSC Technical Memorandum 338)
source.publisher: NOAA Fisheries / Northeast Fisheries Science Center

notes: NOAA's latest stock assessment estimates the population bottomed out at 358 whales in 2020 and has crept up since: 376 in 2023, 384 at the start of 2024 (95% credible interval 375-394).
